title: A flexibility-pneumatic triboelectric nanogenerator for stable output of irregular wave energy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00211G, Paper
Jianlong Wang, Zheng Yang, Zhenjie Wang, Xinxian Wang, Yanrui Zhao, Jinbiao Ma, Hengyu Li, Yang Yu, Zhong Lin Wang, Tinghai Cheng
An FP-TENG can adaptively deform to accommodate variable wave conditions and convert irregular wave energy into a high-frequency stable output. Employing a power management circuit, an FP-TENG can achieve a pulse current output of 1.28 A.
